# BazzBasic

> BazzBasic is a modern, beginner-friendly BASIC interpreter for Windows x64, built on .NET 10 with SDL2 graphics and SDL2_mixer sound. It keeps the feel of classic BASICs (QBasic, GW-BASIC, MSX, C64, Spectrum) while adding modern features such as typeless variables, dynamic associative arrays, JSON support, recursive user-defined functions, INCLUDE files and tokenized libraries. Open source under the MIT license, created and maintained by Kristian Virtanen (EkBass).

Key facts for writing BazzBasic code correctly:

- All variables end with `$` and all constants end with `#`. The suffix does NOT mean "string": variables are typeless and hold either numbers or strings (`LET n$ = 42`, `LET s$ = "Hello"`).
- Arrays are declared with `DIM name$` and are fully dynamic, indexed by numbers, strings or both (`a$("name") = "John"`).
- Functions are defined with `DEF FN name$(args$) ... END DEF`, return values with `RETURN`, and are called with `FN name$(...)`. Recursion is supported.
- Graphics and sound programs need `SDL2.dll` (and SDL2_mixer for sound) in the same folder; console-only programs do not.
- Command line: `bazzbasic.exe file.bas` runs a program, `bazzbasic.exe -exe file.bas` builds a standalone executable, `bazzbasic.exe -lib file.bas` builds a tokenized library.
- Do not assume QBasic or FreeBASIC syntax applies unchanged; check the manual pages below.

## Documentation

- [Installation](https://ekbass.github.io/BazzBasic/manual/installation.md): download, first run, external editors, command-line options
- [Variables & Constants](https://ekbass.github.io/BazzBasic/manual/variables-and-constants.md): the `$` and `#` suffixes and typeless values
- [Arrays & JSON](https://ekbass.github.io/BazzBasic/manual/arrays_and_json.md): dynamic and associative arrays, JSON handling
- [User-defined Functions](https://ekbass.github.io/BazzBasic/manual/user-defined-functions.md): DEF FN, parameters, RETURN, recursion
- [Graphics](https://ekbass.github.io/BazzBasic/manual/graphics.md): SDL2 screen modes, shapes, images, sprites, animation
- [Sounds](https://ekbass.github.io/BazzBasic/manual/sounds.md): SDL2_mixer playback, background and blocking modes
- [Preprocessor](https://ekbass.github.io/BazzBasic/manual/preprocessor.md): INCLUDE and splitting code across files
- [Libraries](https://ekbass.github.io/BazzBasic/manual/libraries.md): generating and using tokenized libraries
- [IDE Usage](https://ekbass.github.io/BazzBasic/manual/ide-usage.md): the bundled editor
- [Beginner's Guide (manual)](https://ekbass.github.io/BazzBasic/manual/beginners-guide.md): first steps in programming with BazzBasic
- [Online Manual](https://ekbass.github.io/BazzBasic/manual/#/): full browsable manual
- [Quick Guide](https://ekbass.github.io/BazzBasic/start.html): short introduction

## Examples

- [Example programs](https://github.com/EkBass/BazzBasic/tree/main/Examples): official example code
- [Egg Catcher](https://github.com/EkBass/BazzBasic/blob/main/Examples/graphics/Egg_Catcher.bas): a complete small game in a few lines
- [Raycaster 3D](https://github.com/EkBass/BazzBasic/blob/main/Examples/graphics/Raycaster_3d_optimized.bas): larger graphics example
- [Rosetta Code examples](https://ekbass.github.io/BazzBasic/manual/rosetta-code.md): standard tasks solved in BazzBasic

## AI resources

- [BazzBasic AI Guide](https://huggingface.co/datasets/EkBass/BazzBasic_AI_Guide): SKILL file written to help AI assistants write correct BazzBasic code
- [BazzBasic dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/EkBass/BazzBasic): dataset with thousands of Q&A pairs about BazzBasic ready to be used for finetuning.
